hints.title: Digit Position Signs
hints.text: The most significant digit receives a positive sign, the next receives a negative sign, alternating across all digits.

hints.title: String Conversion Indexing
hints.text: Convert n to its string representation so that index 0 corresponds to the most significant digit.

hints.title: Alternating Accumulation
hints.text: Multiply digit at index i by +1 if i is even, or -1 if i is odd, and sum the results.

hints.title: Alternating Digit Sum Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass iterating through decimal digits of n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(log10 n) space for string representation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies alternating signs indexed from the most significant digit.
